Every included model/method uses all 840 instances (168 per HCL) with the same prompts, output cap and acceptance pipeline. C0 errors are blind-gate rejections, including invalid/truncated source output. Native and RTL pass indicators follow sequential acceptance. All paired comparisons and the exact Holm family size are recorded in table_vii_viii_paired_holm.json. Claude uses the confirmed Anthropic Messages transport. Its endpoint does not accept seed/reasoning_effort or the deprecated temperature/top_p controls; these nominal fields in the canonical request are omitted on the wire, so identical sampling control across families is not claimed. Every selected Claude candidate has its own generation and official evaluation record; parse failures remain in the fixed denominator. A support contract that still fails after two schema-only corrections terminates that repair branch, retains the accepted predecessor, and charges all support attempts; the corresponding instance remains in /840. Contract output failures are explicitly flagged in exp4_instance_scores.csv.
